## Galiwatch Bee Book: Third Edition Now Available!

New species: We've added 17 new bee species to our database, incorporating recent discoveries from iNaturalist, the International Barcode of Life project, GBIF, and the [NBSBC Bee Atlas](https://www.bcnativebees.org/bc-bee-atlas). This brings the number of species currently documented in the pacific maritime to a grand total of 300.
